title: Chapter 1333
text:
Somewhere in the World Tree Civilization, an artificial teleportation wormhole suddenly appeared and expanded. A few unmanned engineering ships sailed out and quickly set up shielding devices and communication bases.

After the temporary base station was completed, the three direct Beyond Grade A Mechanics from the three Universal Civilizations used this as a springboard to send the veda over.

In the data field, the quantum souls of 'Guardian' Romo, 'Quantum Demon' Judith, and the others appeared. In their vision was the quantum network node that was connected into a bright sea of stars.

"Pay attention to the data disguise. If there are any abnormalities, immediately disconnect the connection."

Judith sternly exhorted him.

After the initial preparations, the three Universal Civilizations officially carried out the network intelligence theft plan today. They sent out three direct Mechanics to use the computing power of the main artificial intelligence of each civilization to browse the World Tree Civilization's network.

The World Tree channel was a springboard. Now, the wormhole coordinates that the three Universal Civilizations had explored were not only the data left behind by EsGod. To be safe, they changed locations almost every time they attacked, and they rarely used the same wormhole coordinates again.

This was the first time this coordinate was used. They planned to temporarily seal it after stealing the network intelligence.

The three of them did not have the time to waste. Using the basic coding language that they had deciphered not long ago, they cooperated with their teammates to infiltrate a quantum network node and began to collect data on a large scale, searching for public information on the network.

Every second, a huge amount of data was packed and uploaded to the high-encryption information processing library temporarily opened by the three Universal Civilizations' main artificial intelligence.

The three Universal Civilizations monitored the situation remotely, and their efficiency was extremely fast. It did not take long for them to complete the operation.

The engineering ship immediately dismantled and retrieved all the devices, leaving behind a few strange-looking bombs on the spot before returning to the explored universe through the wormhole.

After the engineering ship returned, the three Universal Civilizations closed the World Tree channel on the other side of the wormhole. The artificial wormhole quickly shrank and disappeared.

Then, the bombs that had been left in this area in advance exploded at the right time. Chaotic energy waves spread out, covering this area and erasing all traces.

Peace was restored in the area, as if nothing had happened.

After an unknown period of time, a spatial rift suddenly appeared, and a translucent blue-green root stretched out from it. It was extremely large.

Ripples appeared on the surface of the root, and a fleet flew out. At first, it was a little blurry, like a phantom. When it completely left the root, the appearance of the fleet suddenly solidified.

"This is the abnormal reaction area shown by the Information Form Alert Network. Holy Tree Emissary, do you want to start the inspection?"

In the command room of the main ship, the captain stood beside a tall figure and respectfully asked for instructions.

This tall figure was called Barbani, and it had a ferocious appearance. It looked like some kind of arthropod. It was wearing battle armor, and there was a weak blue-green energy around it. It was not the same species as the crew around it.

Within the World Tree Civilization, the Holy Tree Emissaries were a special group. They had a high status and were one of the executors of the highest will. Only individuals who had a deep connection with the World Tree could take on the role. They could use some of the World Tree's abilities, such as fast travel, physical transformation, and so on.

"Activate the Information Form Camera and see what's going on here." Barbani's voice was short and sharp.

This kind of device could retrace what had happened in an area at the information state level. The higher the power, the longer the retraced time, and the clearer the details.

Once the order was given, the fleet quickly got to work. Light green screens scanned the surroundings, but there was no reaction from the areas they scanned.

"Barbarian". Barbarian Barded Barbarian Barbarian Barbarian Bara Barbarian

The captain glanced at the scan results and quickly came to a conclusion.

"Even the traces of the older Information Form have disappeared, which proves that the outsiders have mastered a certain level of Information Form technology. The level of their civilization is not low."

"Looks like we have new prey." Barbani was excited.

The captain glanced at the time and analyzed, "Judging from the time difference between us and the scene, the intruder's goal may be to enter our quantum network and steal information."

"That's a good thing."

Barbani didn't care.

He wasn't worried about the information being leaked on the Internet at all. The higher-ups wouldn't be able to find out the key secrets. At the same time, it was also a layer of bait.

The Information Form Warning Network covered the entire information collection of the World Tree Civilization. It could detect if an outsider was spying on it. As long as it was entangled with the information collection, it would send out a warning. However, it was only limited to the alarm, and there was no way to steal the other party's information. Therefore, they could only discover that there was an outsider spying on them, but they did not know the other party's specific situation.

However, this was not a problem. The World Tree itself had the characteristics of a high-dimensional information body. The more outsiders knew of its existence, or the deeper the interference between the two sets of information, the more obvious the connection would be.

As long as the interaction reached a certain standard, the World Tree would be able to send out a revelation and sense the direction of the other party's information collection. Then, it would send a long-distance team to search in that direction. They would eventually find the other party.

This was also like the soul connection of a Universal Treasure. It could be located remotely, but the relationship was reversed.

Most Universal Treasures found it difficult to establish a soul connection. They were extremely cold, and even if they acknowledged their masters, they would only accept them half-heartedly. The Evolution Cube and the Spacetime Amber were both like this, but the World Tree was a Universal Treasure that did not reject anyone.

However, outsiders could only 'rub against it' and would not be able to obtain any substantial benefits from it. Instead, they would expose themselves.

This was similar to how if you said my name, I would be able to know you. It was similar to the characteristics of some information life forms in the universe, as if it had divinity.

Therefore, the information on the quantum network was a kind of bait to catch the 'fish' in the universe that had the ability to discover them and find prey.

However, the information on the network was not fake data. It was indeed real information left behind by the daily activities of countless people. It was just that all the secrets about the World Tree itself were strictly restricted and not allowed to be uploaded.

"Alright, your mission is complete."

Barbani let out a sharp laugh.

"I'll suggest that the Tree King activate all the Information Perceivers in the Future Form to see if he can foresee the information of this group of outsiders in advance. Let's go."

As soon as he said that, the blue-green energy on his body suddenly surged.

The huge roots that were quietly lying at the side seemed to have received a signal. They suddenly curled up and swallowed the fleet before quickly retracting into the spatial rift.

The next moment, the spatial rift quickly closed as if it had never existed.

…

A few days later, on a secret training planet in the Black Star Corps' territory.

Han Xiao floated in outer space and looked down at the two meteors chasing each other on the ground. They collided time and time again, leaving huge craters on the ground. Dust and sand billowed.

One of them was Lothaire, and the other was Carrott, who was undergoing special training.

Lothaire controlled his strength and constantly trained Carrott in actual combat. While imparting his martial arts insights, he was also practicing his precise control of his skyrocketing strength. Carrott was like a sponge, rapidly absorbing the essence and enriching himself.

"After finding the right cultivation method, this guy's improvement will be rapid."

Han Xiao, who was watching the battle from above, nodded in satisfaction.

Not only Carrott, he had also been training the other Beyond Grade A seeds in the past few days. He taught them according to their aptitude and provided customized cultivation plans. The effect was not bad. He felt that if this continued for a long time, many seeds should be able to 'sprout'.

Beep beep …

At this moment, his communicator rang.

Han Xiao took a look. It was a message from the three Universal Civilizations. Inside was the information about the World Tree Civilization that they had stolen from the network. It had been fully analyzed.

He raised his eyebrows and immediately focused his attention on the book.

Because the players' intelligence channels were limited, it was very difficult for them to touch on high-level secrets. His understanding of the World Tree Civilization came from the war period in his previous life, and it was basically common knowledge at that time.

He knew very little about the situation of the World Tree Civilization at this point in time, and this information would help him deepen his understanding.

"… When there is no war, the daily life of the World Tree Civilization is similar to that of the galactic society. Speaking of which, in my previous life, the three Universal Civilizations have always been dealing with invasions and have never attacked the territory of the World Tree Civilization. This is the first time I've seen a detailed star map of their territory."

Han Xiao looked through it carefully and realized that it was all ordinary information. None of it was as important as the secrets of the World Tree's main body that he had provided.

At the end of the message, he found a note from the three Universal Civilizations, indicating that they would fulfill the agreement after some time and acknowledge the association's position.

"Although it hasn't verified the accuracy of the secrets I provided, the other ordinary information matches up. The three Universal Civilizations shouldn't doubt me anymore …"

As he was reading the message, his communicator suddenly rang again. Han Xiao took a look. It was a message from Oathkeeper, and the content made his heart tighten.

"Destiny's Child suddenly had an abnormal reaction?"

Han Xiao's eyes twitched.

If he remembered correctly, the last time Destiny's Child had an abnormal reaction was when the Intelligent Plague broke out in advance. Furthermore, it had created a new batch of sub-bodies, and one of them was in his hands.

This was something that Oathkeeper had told him personally after he had built a good relationship with him.

At this juncture, Destiny's Child had caused trouble again. He felt that it was definitely not a good thing.
